summary_en: 4,100,000 shares (14% S/O) authorized under ¥820M limit; Jan 30–Dec 11, 2026 execution window; open-market method. Cumulative to July 1, 2026: 3,514,700 shares acquired for ¥785.9M (96% of yen limit consumed). June 2026 monthly take: 896,700 shares, ¥194.6M.
title_en: Notice on progress of share acquisition
translation_en_brief: On July 1, 2026, MBK Co., Ltd. announced the progress of its share buyback authorized by board resolutions of December 12, 2025 and May 18, 2026. The program authorizes acquisition of up to 4,100,000 shares (14% of shares outstanding, excluding treasury) within a ¥820 million budget from January 30 to December 11, 2026, using open-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. As of July 1, 2026, the company has cumulatively acquired 3,514,700 shares for ¥785.928 million, consuming 96% of the authorized yen limit and 85.7% of the share authorization. In June 2026 alone, 896,700 shares were purchased for ¥194.584 million. The disclosure does not state a specific price ceiling; the yen amount constrains the program. Treasury holdings as of July 1 stood at 3,534,406 shares against 32,806,190 issued shares.
